title: Kami
notes: Master 99 title is now KAMI 神 (god).

NEW talent branch Ascension (opens in the Master League): Godly Power, Divine Body, Kami Eye, Spirit Sovereign, keystones Divine Wrath and Endless Ki, and Limit Break that takes every leftover point. +10 buttons for big nodes.
Hover tooltip now also works on your equipped gear (Champion tab) and on loot; it hides cleanly when you move away, scroll, press a key or click.
Master League paced for about 3 hours to Master 99 at x3 speed: masters are tougher, master XP lower, no more wall at Master 40-50.
Endgame Mana Stones: stone cost capped, Master League and Master Gate give more stones.
